build.UNIT_TEST: MANUAL: no test runner configured yet — CLAUDE.md plans Vitest + React Testing Library; until then verify with TYPECHECK + LINT and a manual dev-server check

researchLayers.name: components
researchLayers.targets: src/components/, composition, props contracts, styling usage

researchLayers.name: state
researchLayers.targets: src/contexts/, custom hooks, URL-driven state, window events

researchLayers.name: api-types
researchLayers.targets: src/services/api.ts methods, src/types/index.ts shapes, backend contracts, auth/session lifecycle

manualVerificationSurfaces: Dev server route — DEV_SERVER, then the specific path the change affects
Responsive check — mobile and desktop widths, plus the dark-mode variant if the app has one
Browser console + network tab — no errors, and the expected request/response shape
Loading and error states — exercise both, not just the happy path
sliceExample: Slice 1: types + the api method in the apiBoundary (TYPECHECK, LINT). Slice 2: the component consuming it, with loading and error states wired (TYPECHECK, LINT, BUILD). Slice 3: the route/page it lands on plus its e2e spec (BUILD, E2E_TEST).
triggerVocabulary: components, pages, routing, hooks, contexts, state, API client, styling, storefront, cart, checkout
_notes: Starter profile for a React/Vite TypeScript storefront. Copy to working-docs/config.json and adjust.

The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative: functional components + named exports, all backend calls through apiBoundary (src/services/api.ts), typed responses, loading + error states, user-feedback helpers, styling ordering with dark: variants.
When a test runner lands, replace UNIT_TEST with 'npx vitest run' and add it to the ts|tsx mapping.

E2E_TEST assumes Playwright, matching the '*.spec.ts|tests' mapping. If the target repo has no playwright.config.* or no specs, change E2E_TEST and E2E_TEST_ONE to 'MANUAL: no e2e runner' AND drop that mapping — leaving a mapping pointed at a verb that cannot run is a checkpoint that never passes.
A verb that runs zero tests is not a pass. Read the reported count before calling a checkpoint green.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session.
